en: Vintage illustrated postcard cover showing a riverside cityscape labeled LYON. In the center is a colored drawing of a bridge over a river with quays, a large church or cathedral on the right bank, and a hill in the background topped by a basilica and a metal tower. Decorative floral motifs frame the image, and large ornate lettering at the top spells 'LYON'. French text at the bottom mentions 'Édition Artistique E.R.' and 'cartes détachables'.
